floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Greenway 2 townhouse design and layout
floorPlans.note: Imperial figures follow the original sheets. The Ivy TH02 and TH03 plans print different metric suite figures for the same imperial suite area. Confirm the signed plan for your home.

review.images: Reviewed five developer gallery scenes and the wide hero. Used five distinct views after removing the narrower duplicate terrace shot. The street facade supplies the card, plus a living room and bedroom for the editorial panels.
review.location: Matched Greenway 2’s own location point, separate from Greenway, and the regional map. Verified five driving estimates on physical brochure page 3.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 11 physical pages and selected eight original residence drawings. Verified all area panels against independent PDF extraction and arithmetic. Ivy TH02 prints 184.16 sq m and TH03 prints 183.83 sq m for the same 1,978.73 sq ft suite. The displayed imperial totals match their components. The source tables and separate facade covers are preserved.

unavailable: A corrected metric suite table, signed plot-specific plans and entrance coordinates were not verified.
